description: A clock with three embedded layers of tuplets, each layer running at a ratio against the layer above it

params.text: Sets the tempo, doubling for every step of the knob about 120 bpm at its default, and spanning 15 bpm to 3840 bpm
Sets the numerator of tuplet 1's ratio against the main tempo, 1 to 24
Sets the denominator of tuplet 1's ratio against the main tempo, 1 to 24
Sets the numerator of tuplet 2's ratio against tuplet 1, 1 to 24
Sets the denominator of tuplet 2's ratio against tuplet 1, 1 to 24
Sets the numerator of tuplet 3's ratio against tuplet 2, 1 to 24
Sets the denominator of tuplet 3's ratio against tuplet 2, 1 to 24
Sets the probability that tuplet 1 puts out its pulse, 0 to 100%
Sets the probability that tuplet 2 puts out its pulse, 0 to 100%
Sets the probability that tuplet 3 puts out its pulse, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: A trigger resets the phase of the clock and of all three tuplets
An external clock, read either as a voltage setting the tempo or as pulses per quarter note, according to the External Clock Mode on the menu
Sets the numerator of tuplet 1's ratio, 12 per volt, so 0V to 2V covers 0 through 24
Sets the denominator of tuplet 1's ratio, 12 per volt, so 0V to 2V covers 0 through 24
Sets the numerator of tuplet 2's ratio, 12 per volt, so 0V to 2V covers 0 through 24
Sets the denominator of tuplet 2's ratio, 12 per volt, so 0V to 2V covers 0 through 24
Sets the numerator of tuplet 3's ratio, 12 per volt, so 0V to 2V covers 0 through 24
Sets the denominator of tuplet 3's ratio, 12 per volt, so 0V to 2V covers 0 through 24

outputs.text: Fires a pulse at the tempo set by the BPM knob
Fires pulses at tuplet 1's ratio against the main tempo
Fires pulses at tuplet 2's ratio against tuplet 1
Fires pulses at tuplet 3's ratio against tuplet 2

notes: in the pulses-per-quarter-note clock modes the clock starts by itself when pulses arrive and stops when they stop
the clock is stopped when the module is added, so no pulses come out until the toggle button is pressed.
menu: External Clock Mode — how the EXT jack is read: CV (0V = 120 bpm), or 2 PPQN, 4 PPQN, 8 PPQN, 12 PPQN or 24 PPQN pulses per quarter note
